gaps.explanation: The p16 General Fund Schedule by Department prints 'Operating transfers in (out)' per department: General (623,230), Fire 65,441, Police 344,170, Pool 51,963, Park 100,339, Summer Youth 10,765, Library 150,552, Totals 100,000. detail[] records them gross (Transfers In 723,230 and Transfers Out -623,230, all General Fund); 623,230 of the inflows are moves between General Fund departments, so the fund's net transfer in is 723,230 - 623,230 = 100,000, which equals the p6 statement Operating transfers in 100,000 (General column). Nothing is missing or doubled; the schedule simply shows intra-fund departmental transfers gross.
